tokens.name: surface-base
tokens.usage: Page background: the matte shell. Everything sits on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, inputs: one step lighter than the page (dark: one step lifted).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells and tracks: toggle track off, code blocks, segmented-control ground.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: The rubber thumb-pad: dark feature panels, strong buttons, tooltips. Text on it is `on-graphite`. In dark it is close to the page, so a graphite panel there also takes a `line` border.

tokens.name: on-graphite
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `graphite` in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges (decorative, 1px). Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, quiet buttons, toggle off): 3:1 on `surface-base` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `surface-base`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, mono labels on `surface-base`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken` (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and disabled labels only; on `surface-raised` (≥3:1 in light, ≥4.5:1 in dark; not for content).

tokens.name: signal-500
tokens.usage: THE accent: primary buttons, toggle on, focus ring, the red hairline markings. Text on it is `on-signal`. Once or twice per view.

tokens.name: signal-400
tokens.usage: Hover state of `signal-500` fills; decorative marks.

tokens.name: signal-300
tokens.usage: Ramp step: charts and decorative tints only, never text.

tokens.name: signal-200
tokens.usage: Ramp step: selection highlight, chart fills.

tokens.name: signal-100
tokens.usage: Softest tint: signal badge ground, selected-row ground. Text on it is `signal-ink`.

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Red text and links on `surface-base`, `surface-raised` and `signal-100` (≥4.5:1 in both themes). Errors use it with an icon or word.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `signal-500` (white in light, near-black in dark where the red is lighter).

tokens.name: led-500
tokens.usage: The status LED: a small dot meaning on / live / connected. A mark, never text; always beside a word.

tokens.name: led-100
tokens.usage: Ground of the success badge. Text on it is `led-ink`.

tokens.name: led-ink
tokens.usage: Success text on `surface-base`, `surface-raised` and `led-100` (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: amber-100
tokens.usage: Ground of the warning badge. Text on it is `amber-ink`.

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text on `surface-base`, `surface-raised` and `amber-100` (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring, 2px offset in the page colour. ≥3:1 on every surface.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every service reports to one collector.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The engraved marking: UPPERCASE eyebrow labels, axis labels, card kickers. Set in `ink-muted` or `signal-ink`.

styles.name: readout-lg
styles.usage: Headline metric on a stat card.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tick-mark length.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside controls; badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding; card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections inside a view.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page gutters on desktop; section spacing on marketing pages.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero and major section breaks.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, tick-sized chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs: the mouse's small key caps.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large feature panels and the graphite thumb-pad block.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggles, status pills, the LED dot.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards and raised buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, popovers, menus: the soft studio shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs and hero objects only.

tokens.name: shadow-inset
tokens.usage: Wells: input fields and toggle tracks.

size.note: Control heights. Every interactive target is at least 36px tall on touch surfaces.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Dense toolbars and table actions (pointer only).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary calls to action and touch layouts.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, card edges, the red marking lines.
